description:
Gary Nel from Leonard Wilson Keenan Estate & Letting Agents is delighted to present No. 118 Silverspring Court, Tivoli to the market—an impressive four-bedroom semi-detached residence offering exceptional versatility, generous living accommodation and a sought-after address just minutes from Cork City Centre.

Beautifully maintained throughout, this elegant family home combines timeless charm with modern practicality. A private driveway provides valuable off-street parking, while the attractive façade immediately creates a warm and welcoming first impression.

Stepping inside, a bright entrance hallway leads to two beautifully proportioned reception rooms, both enhanced by feature fireplaces, that create inviting spaces for relaxing and entertaining. Gas-fired central heating ensures a comfortable environment throughout the home. To the rear, a spacious wooden kitchen and large dining area forms the heart of the home, offering an ideal setting for everyday family life and social gatherings.

A standout feature of the property is the ground-floor fourth bedroom, created through a high-quality garage conversion. Complete with its own ensuite bathroom and direct access from the hallway and kitchen, this versatile space is perfectly suited for guests, multi-generational living or a stylish home office.

Upstairs, the property offers three generously sized bedrooms, all filled with natural light, together with a well-appointed family bathroom, ensuring excellent accommodation for growing families.

The large private rear garden provides an excellent outdoor retreat, with ample space for entertaining, children's play or gardening, while a garden shed offers practical additional storage.

With a BER rating of D, this home delivers an attractive balance of comfort and energy efficiency.

Situated within the highly desirable Tivoli neighbourhood, residents enjoy easy access to excellent primary and secondary schools, local shops, cafés, sporting facilities and regular public transport. The Jack Lynch Tunnel, Mahon Point Shopping Centre, Cork City Centre and major road networks are all within easy reach, making this an exceptional location for commuters and families alike.

Key Features

- BER D
- Impressive four-bedroom semi-detached home
- Gas-fired central heating
- Ground-floor bedroom with ensuite
- Quality garage conversion with direct hallway access
- Two elegant reception rooms with feature fireplaces
- Spacious kitchen and dining area
- Three generously sized first-floor bedrooms
- Well-appointed family bathroom
- Private driveway with off-street parking
- Large private rear garden
- Garden shed for additional storage
- Prime Tivoli location with excellent access to Cork City and surrounding amenities

Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the quality, space and versatility this exceptional family home has to offer.
